title:
🌯 EASY HOMEMADE CHICKEN DONER 🌯

Big flavour, simple ingredients and so easy to make at home 🤤 Save this one to try!

For the marinade:
• 3 tbsp cumin
• 2 tbsp chilli powder
• 1 tbsp all-purpose seasoning
• 2 tsp garlic & herb seasoning
• 1 tbsp paprika
• 1 tsp mixed herbs
• 1 small bunch fresh coriander
• 5–8 garlic cloves
• 2 small onions
• 1 large red pepper
• 1 chilli 🌶️
• 5 tbsp yoghurt

#healthyfood #donnerkebab #recipe
